# Viavo

> Viavo: AI Car Voice Assistant — a tap-to-talk voice assistant for drivers on iPhone and Apple CarPlay. Press one button, say what you need in your own words, and Viavo does it and answers out loud: routes in your navigator with stops on the way, places along the route, music and live radio, calls, WhatsApp and SMS drafts, Telegram and Slack, reminders, calendar and questions. It speaks 28 languages with a native voice, including Polish, Czech, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian and Ukrainian, which Siri does not speak.

Key facts:
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 17 or later) and Apple CarPlay. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761760437
- Price: free download with 10 free credits; Viavo Plus is a monthly or yearly subscription with a free first week (one per account).
- How it starts: one big button on the CarPlay screen, no wake word; the steering-wheel voice button stays with Siri.
- Works with Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze; Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer; Simple Radio, TuneIn, iHeartRadio.
- Made by a small team in Serbia.
